response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.mean_share) AS average_excess_over_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.mean_share

assumptions.assumption: Members with a NULL link_to_major form their own group (as GROUP BY does), and they count in the total and in the average across groups.
Share = group count / total number of members. The average share is the unweighted mean of the group shares, taken across all groups.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude members with no major (NULL link_to_major) from the groups, the total and the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.mean_share) AS average_excess_over_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.mean_share
